That section presents the jump-square convention and product formula via Itô’s formula, but does not provide the finite-variation partition-sum route described here; the carrier’s own proof supplies that route ([Bass, SDEs with Jumps](https://sites.math.duke.edu/~rtd/CPSS2007/Basscornell.pdf)).
